blocks.text: Hypotheses mukhtalif qismon mein baante jate hain, aur har qism ka apna maqsad hai. Sab se aam qismein null aur alternative hypotheses hain. Yeh dono testing mein mil kar kaam karti hain. Durust hypotheses uljhan kam kar ke analysis ka miyar behtar karte hain aur faisla karne mein rehnumai karte hain. Hypotheses ki qismein samajhna zaroori hai, kyunke yahi hypothesis testing ki bunyad hain.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Talaba marks ya percentage ki kisi surat-e-haal ke liye ek null aur ek alternative hypothesis likhein, phir class mein guftagu karein ke woh durust hain ya nahi.

Null hypothesis kehta hai ke koi asar (effect) ya farq (difference) nahi hai. Ise default assumption (pehle se maani hui baat) ke taur par likha jata hai. Data ko isi hypothesis ke khilaf test kiya jata hai. Agar saboot mazboot ho to null hypothesis reject (radd) kar diya jata hai. Ise aam taur par H₀ se dikhaya jata hai. Null hypothesis bias se bachata hai aur muqable (comparison) ki bunyad deta hai. Bohat se tests isi hypothesis se shuru hote hain, aur faisla karne mein yeh aham hai.

Alternative hypothesis kehta hai ke asar ya farq maujood hai. Ise null hypothesis ka ulat (opposite) likha jata hai, aur H₁ ya Hₐ se dikhaya jata hai. Testing ka maqsad aksar isi hypothesis ko support karna hota hai. Ise accept karne ke liye mazboot saboot chahiye. Yeh tabdeeli ya asar (impact) ko dikhata hai. Alternative hypotheses research ki simt batate hain aur mutawaqqa (expected) nataij samjhate hain. Testing dono hypotheses ka muqabla karti hai.
Research questions aur hypotheses ka namoona:
Research question: Kya parhai ka waqt (study time) talaba ke exam scores par asar dalta hai?
H₀ (null hypothesis): Parhai ke waqt aur exam scores mein koi numayan (significant) rishta nahi hai.
H₁ (alternative hypothesis): Parhai ke waqt ki miqdar talaba ke exam scores par numayan asar dalti hai.

blocks.alt: 'Kya parhai ka waqt imtihani score par asar dalta hai?' research sawal ka dabba do dabbon mein bat'ta: null hypothesis H0 (koi asar ya farq nahi: parhai ke waqt ka score se numayan rishta nahi) aur alternative hypothesis H1 ya Ha (asar ya farq: parhai ka waqt score par numayan asar). Note: test H0 farz kar ke shuru hota, aur us ke khilaf mazboot saboot ka matlab H0 radd kar ke H1 ke haq mein.
blocks.caption: Research question aur us ke do hypotheses (7.2 ki misaal par apna khaaka).
blocks.long_description: H0 aur H1 ko mil kar tamam imkanat dhanpne chahiye, taake aik ko radd karna doosre ki taraf ishara kare.

blocks.text: Durust hypotheses wazeh aur specific (mukhtasar aur saaf) hone chahiye, aur data se test ho sakne chahiye. Mubham (vague) bayan durusti kam karte hain. Hypotheses research question ke mutabiq hon aur variables wazeh tor par bataye jayein. Saadi zaban samajh barhati hai. Durust hypothesis banane se waqt bachta hai, nataij qabil-e-bharosa (reliable) aate hain aur analysis ka miyar behtar hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Dukaandar ka daawa hai ke naye display ne rozana ki average farokht Rs 20,000 se zyada kar di hai. H0 aur H1 likhein.
blocks.explanation: H0: naye display ke saath rozana average farokht Rs 20,000 ya kam hai (koi izafa nahi). H1: rozana average farokht Rs 20,000 se zyada hai.

items: H₀: koi asar ya farq nahi; data isi ke khilaf test hota hai.
H₁ (Hₐ): asar ya farq hai; sirf mazboot saboot par accept.
Achha hypothesis: wazeh, specific, testable aur sawal ke mutabiq.
